hero_headline: Score Big with Sports Trivia Quiz Videos

example_questions.question: Which country has won the most FIFA World Cup titles?
In basketball, how many points is a free throw worth?

faq.question: What sports trivia topics get the most views on YouTube Shorts?
faq.answer: Player records and comparisons, 'who scored more goals' head-to-heads, and underdog stories consistently outperform other sports content. Fans love debating statistics, which drives comments and shares — two key algorithm boosters.

faq.question: Can I use team logos or player images in sports quiz videos?
faq.answer: League logos and player images may trigger copyright and right-of-publicity claims. QuizViral AI solves this by rendering all content as stylized text animations with theme-appropriate color schemes, avoiding any trademarked imagery.

faq.question: How often should I post sports quiz content?
faq.answer: Daily posting is recommended during major sporting events like the World Cup, Olympics, or Super Bowl season. Timely content tied to live events gets amplified by platform algorithms and can generate 3-5x more views than evergreen content.
